Generalized georeferenced positions, not verified GIS centerlines. Upstream inflow gauges with measured discharge are labeled in the right-hand rail; major mainstem stations are labeled on the left. Labels are kept outside the channel geometry. Blue identifies gauge-anchored discharge; green represents reach-by-reach continuity from the latest upstream measured discharge. Light green flags unmeasured mapped tributaries or outflows; these are not assumed zero. Gray indicates no upstream measured discharge anchor. Mainstem and tributary widths share one discharge scale; measured tributaries are blue, explicitly estimated tributaries light green, and unknown flows gray. Click a reach to inspect its mass-balance terms. Embedded data are a dated snapshot, not live. NWM forecasts remain separate.
